sloka: प्रत्याख्याता नृपतयः तन् निबोध तपोधन ।ततः परम कोपेन राजानो मुनिपुंगव ॥१-६६-२०॥
transliteration: pratyākhyātā nṛpatayaḥ tan nibodha tapodhana ।tataḥ parama kopena rājāno munipuṁgava ॥1-66-20॥

translations.english: O Mighty ascetic, thereafter all the kings doubting their own strength in stringing the bow were inflamed with anger and laid siege on Mithila.
